subject: DPA request: data retention & evidence for FinHealth onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Mora <elena.mora@finhealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, contracts@finhealth.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: DPA and evidence request for FinHealth onboarding

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — FinHealth is excited to move forward. Before procurement can issue a PO we need: a counter-signed DPA (we've attached our standard clauses below), a HIPAA BAA or equivalent addendum, confirmation that SCCs cover EU transfers, and copies of the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and security architecture diagram.

Two specific asks from legal:
- Retention: we require 7 years retention for PHI and related audit logs for regulatory purposes.
- DPIA evidence / data flow mapping for EU residents.

Can you confirm you can provide these and a timeline for signature? Procurement would like the DPA returned executed or a DocuSign link by EOD next week if possible.

Thanks,
Elena Mora

Thanks for the ping. Quick summary of redline guidance (see attached redline):
- Retention: Redwood standard = 3 years for customer data / PHI. We should not accept a blanket 7-year obligation. Recommend we offer: 3 years default + option for customer to request extended retention up to 5 years for specific datasets with exec approval and documented business justification (we can allow legal hold exceptions).
- SCCs / international transfers: accept SCCs; provide mapping and copy of our controller-processor flow; no substantive change needed.
- HIPAA: we will provide HIPAA addendum/BAA as an addendum to the DPA — standard template attached.
- SOC 2: we can provide SOC 2 Type II report under NDA; also provide a one-page security architecture diagram and encrypted logs retention summary.

Escalations: If customer insists on >5 years retention or wants Redwood to act as a long-term data archive for PHI, we need exec signoff (karthik_iyer). If procurement is pushing 7 years as non-negotiable, we'll need pricing/concession approval.

Attaching: Redlined_DPA_FH.docx, HIPAA_Addendum_Redwood.pdf, SOC2_TypeII_Summary.pdf, SCCs_Mapping_FinHealth.xlsx

-Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
attachments: Redlined_DPA_FH.docx, HIPAA_Addendum_Redwood.pdf, SOC2_TypeII_Summary.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec approval request: retention exception for FinHealth (FH-2026-78)

Karthik — quick note: FinHealth (deal FH-2026-78) is asking for 7 years retention on PHI. Legal recommends default 3 years with an exception path up to 5 years with exec approval. Revenue is expected to be $480k ARR; procurement is firm on the 7-year ask for regulatory reasons.

Requesting your signoff to accept up to 5 years retention for PHI for this customer (subject to: documented business justification, additional controls, and a modest annual fee). If you prefer we push harder, we'll keep standard language and risk slowing the deal.

- Priyom (Contracts)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Mora <elena.mora@finhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed compromise: DPA, HIPAA addendum & evidence (FinHealth)

Hi Elena — thank you for the clear list. After reviewing with our legal and contracts teams, here's what we can provide and the path to signature: 

1) Retention
- Default: 3 years for PHI and related logs.
- Extended retention: up to 5 years for specified datasets by written request + documented business justification + exec approval (we can include a clause requiring procurement to confirm the extension and accept associated fees).
- Legal hold: Redwood will preserve data subject to a properly issued legal hold regardless of retention period.

2) HIPAA / BAA
- We will attach a HIPAA addendum to the DPA and sign a BAA-equivalent. See attached HIPAA_Addendum_Redwood.pdf.

3) SCCs & DPIA
- SCCs mapping attached. We'll provide a DPIA/dataflow summary for EU residents within 3 business days.

4) SOC2 and evidence
- SOC 2 Type II report: available to share under NDA. We've attached a one-page SOC2_TypeII_Summary.pdf; full report can be delivered via secure link after an NDA.

5) Next steps and signature
- Attached is a redline reflecting the compromise (Redlined_DPA_FH.docx). If this is acceptable, we'll send a DocuSign envelope for the DPA + HIPAA addendum.
- DocuSign link (prepped): https://www.docusign.com/sign?env=prod&doc=FH-DPA-2026

If you need Redwood to accept a 7-year default retention for PHI we will need exec approval and an amendment to pricing. Otherwise the 3-year default + exception path should meet regulatory needs while keeping our control obligations reasonable.

Please confirm which option procurement prefers and we'll route the DocuSign accordingly.

Best,
David Kim
Enterprise Account Executive
attachments: Redlined_DPA_FH.docx, HIPAA_Addendum_Redwood.pdf, SOC2_TypeII_Summary.pdf, SCCs_Mapping_FinHealth.xlsx

David / Marissa — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear compromise. Procurement will accept the 3-year default with the documented exception path to 5 years as described, provided Redwood confirms: (a) the exec-approval workflow and (b) that the SOC2 report will be shared under NDA by next Tuesday.

Please send the DocuSign envelope to contracts@finhealth.com and I'll confirm internally. Once we've signed the DPA + BAA, procurement will issue the PO.

Regards,
Elena Mora
Head of Procurement — FinHealth

summary: Customer requested 7-year PHI retention and SOC2 evidence. Redwood proposed 3-year default with exception path to 5 years (exec approval + fee), agreed to provide HIPAA addendum and SOC2 under NDA, and to route DPA via DocuSign. Internal legal flagged >5-year retention as escalation requiring exec signoff.
